Method.Name: filter

Method.Name: ok_or
Method.Summary: Converts the option into a `Result`, with `error` when there is no value.

Union.Name: Result
Union.Summary: The result of an operation that can fail.

Case.Name: ok
Case.Summary: The operation succeeded, with its value.

Case.Summary: The operation failed, with its error.

Method.Name: is_ok

Method.Summary: Whether the result is `err`.

Method.Name: map
Method.Summary: Applies `f` to the value, if the result is `ok`.

Method.Name: map_err
Method.Summary: Applies `f` to the error, if the result is `err`.

Method.Summary: Calls `f` with the value, if the result is `ok`, and returns its result.

Method.Name: ok

Method.Name: err

Method.Summary: Gets the length of the string, in Unicode code points.

Method.Name: starts_with
Method.Summary: Whether the string begins with `prefix`.

Method.Name: skip
Method.Summary: Returns what is left after the first `count` characters.

Method.Name: split
Method.Summary: Splits the string at each `separator`, keeping empty parts.

Method.Name: lines
Method.Summary: Splits the string into lines.

Method.Name: trim_end
Method.Summary: Removes trailing spaces, tabs and line breaks.

Method.Name: pad_left

Method.Name: join

Function.Summary: Returns the arguments the program was run with, without the program name.

Function.Name: eprint
Function.Summary: Writes the text to standard error.

Function.Name: eprintln
Function.Summary: Writes the text to standard error, then a line break.

Function.Name: exit
Function.Summary: Ends the program with the specified code.

Function.Name: panic
Function.Summary: Writes the reason to standard error and ends the program with code 1. With `MEW_BACKTRACE=1` set, it also writes the calls that led to it.

Function.Name: print
Function.Summary: Writes the text to standard output.

Function.Name: println
Function.Summary: Writes the text to standard output, then a line break.

Function.Name: discovered
Function.Summary: Records files the running task read, so a change to them reruns it.

Function.Name: env
Function.Summary: Reads an environment variable. As an `in` binding, a change to it reruns the task.

Function.Name: error
Function.Summary: Writes the text as an error. Does not fail the task.

Function.Name: info
Function.Summary: Writes the text to the build output.

Function.Name: verbose
Function.Summary: Writes the text when the build runs with `--verbose`.

Function.Name: warn
Function.Summary: Writes the text as a warning.

Function.Name: dotnet
Function.Summary: Runs `dotnet` with the arguments.

Function.Name: product_version
Function.Summary: Reads the informational version of the assembly, without anything after a `+`.

Type.Name: BuildFlags

Field.Name: force

Field.Name: trace
Field.Summary: Writes the run to `.mew/trace.json`. Set by `--trace`.

Method.Summary: Runs the task only when `test` returns true.

Method.Name: when_context

Method.Name: teardown
Method.Summary: Sets a function to run after the last task, passing whether the build succeeded.

Method.Name: before
Method.Summary: Sets a function to run before each task.

Method.Name: after
Method.Summary: Sets a function to run after each task, passing whether it succeeded.

Method.Name: execute
Method.Summary: Runs the targets. Returns the exit code.

Case.Name: code

Case.Name: later
